name: North Little Rock
intro: North Little Rock weddings have their own personality, and I've filmed enough of them to know it well. The Venue at Oakdale sits right on the North Little Rock–Sherwood line — ten minutes from my front door — and I've filmed there in both spring and fall, from its chapel with the wall of greenery to its color-shifting reception hall. It's the anchor of this side of the river, and it's a drive I make happily every time.

But NLR is more than one venue. Argenta's brick storefronts and murals make some of the best urban portrait backdrops in the metro, and the riverfront gives you the Little Rock skyline as a backdrop without ever crossing the bridge. For couples marrying on the north side, the whole area works in your film's favor — historic downtown texture, river light in the evening, and venues with real character, all inside a few square miles. And since I'm based just across the river, every bit of it is home turf: no travel fee, no guesswork, just a videographer who already knows where the light will be.

faqs.question: Do you charge a travel fee in North Little Rock?
faqs.answer: No — North Little Rock and Sherwood are minutes from my base. Travel is included, full stop.

faqs.question: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.answer: Nine to twelve months out is the safe window for popular Saturdays. One wedding per date, always — a retainer makes yours official.

faqs.question: When will we get our films?
faqs.answer: Instagram reel within 48 hours; full film by a guaranteed, in-writing date. No mystery timelines.
